title: Step 62-B backend/OpenAPI Compare and Wishlist contract readiness

runtime_contract_findings: POST /compare runtime enforces 1..4 unique products, product existence and same primary category, and returns authoritative price plus comparable specifications; OpenAPI 200 response is currently untyped.
POST /compare/validate runtime returns {valid:true,primary_category_id}; OpenAPI currently exposes generic/untyped success responses including a 202 not produced by runtime.
GET /customer/wishlist runtime returns {items:[{product_id,added_at}]}; OpenAPI 200 response is currently untyped.
POST /customer/wishlist/{product_id} runtime returns 200 with added/product_id/already_present and requires idempotency; OpenAPI response is untyped and advertises 202.
DELETE /customer/wishlist/{product_id} runtime returns 204 and is idempotent; OpenAPI path parameter should use EntityId/uuid authority and authenticated/error responses should align.
evidence.backend_disposition: No backend/domain rewrite is justified by Stage-B discovery. Catalog and Customer runtime files are read-only/forbidden in this task.
evidence.graph_gate: BLOCKING before openapi/generated/test mutation until local FRESH/PASS plus query/path/explain evidence is recorded.

acceptance_criteria.description: Compare validate and compare successful responses are explicitly typed and match current runtime semantics, including max four unique products, same-primary-category validation and authoritative comparable product output.
Wishlist list/add/remove contracts are explicitly typed and match current authenticated runtime semantics, including idempotent add/remove behavior and UUID product identifiers.
OpenAPI success/error/status/security/idempotency declarations do not claim responses the runtime does not produce; generated TypeScript is regenerated byte-for-byte from canonical OpenAPI.
No Catalog/Customer/Auth runtime source, database migration, dependency, Storefront implementation, pricing or inventory authority is changed in 62-B.
Before the first OpenAPI/generated/test mutation, canonical local Graphify health is FRESH/PASS at current base and focused query/path/explain evidence covers Compare and Wishlist dependency paths.
If OpenAPI hash drift triggers recovered Step56/57 provenance checks, only generator-equivalent hash/manifest synchronization is allowed; no design semantics or historical verdicts change.
